name: Data Converter
description: Convert between JSON, YAML, XML, and Properties in one DBX workbench panel, and turn batch text into SQL. Instant conversion, mock data, validation and formatting, field-level JSON diff, a standalone JSON compare page, line-level text compare, and an IN / NOT IN / INSERT value-list generator. A Sheet-to-JSON page reads .xlsx / .csv / .tsv entirely in the browser: header detection, delimiter sniffing, number/boolean inference, real Excel date cells, a live preview table, JSON export, plus hard limits (20 MB / 100k rows) with chunked parsing so the panel never freezes. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.
releaseNotes: 0.1.4 (update): a new Sheet to JSON page — drop in .xlsx / .csv / .tsv and get a JSON array or SQL INSERT statements. Header detection, delimiter sniffing, number/boolean inference, real Excel dates, ZIP64 xlsx support, a preview table and a Max-records cap (All / 100 / 500 / 1k / 5k / 10k). The preview table now scrolls horizontally with a persistent scrollbar and double-clicking a cell opens a detail card with the full value plus the whole row. An optional "row 2 is a note" toggle skips a description row under the header (suggested, never applied silently). Output can be switched between JSON (formatted or compact) and SQL Insert (table name editable, 500 rows per statement); exports go through the host fileTransfer channel so they actually save inside DBX. Large files are capped (20 MB per file, 100k rows) and parsed in chunks so the panel stays responsive.

zh-CN.name: 数据转换
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 工作台里完成 JSON / YAML / XML / Properties 互转，也能把批量文本直接变成 SQL：即时转换、模拟数据、校验与格式化，支持按字段对比 JSON、独立的 JSON 对比页、逐行文本对比，以及 IN / NOT IN / INSERT 值列表生成。另外新增「表格转 JSON」页：直接读 .xlsx / .csv / .tsv，自动识别表头与分隔符、推断数字与布尔、还原 Excel 日期（含 ZIP64 包），边解析边出预览表格，可按「最多条数」限制转换量，输出可在 JSON（格式化 / 紧凑）与 SQL Insert 之间切换并向宿主导出文件；预览表支持横向滚动、双击单元格查看完整内容与整行；「第二行为注释」可选跳过（只提示、不擅自改结果）。单文件 20 MB / 10 万行上限，分批解析不卡界面。纯前端、无后端、可离线运行。

zh-TW.name: 資料轉換
